unit: field plant × site × year; only four independent trial sites, each replicated in 2014 and 2015; do not treat 256 plants or 121 observation periods as independent ecosystems

preoutcome_structural_receipt.field_genotype_annual_balance: 16 SC plus 16 SI at each site and year
preoutcome_structural_receipt.source_method: 30-min array observations, count flowers visited per insect and genotype, matching original Methods; 2015 incomplete 4 open-flower rows (no TOTAL) not admitted as completed observation periods

fixed_analysis.plant_id_join: (year, site numeric code, family-individual string) exactly from First Flower sheet, positions 1-32; no position-only join across sites or years
fixed_analysis.genetic_join: (year, family number, individual number) to corresponding S-locus workbook; A and D fixed in observed field subjects and fully confounded with SC/SI; no independent S-allele fit
fixed_analysis.visit_events: For each complete session signalled by an Open Flowers row and a subsequent TOTAL row, count sequence position tokens H onward per pollinator-event row (numeric F event index and string G taxon); do not count column index as target plant
fixed_analysis.guild_choice_basis: single-visit seed effectiveness shown by the original article, not selected from this dataset's seed output
fixed_analysis.primary_visit_filter: Require source position 1-32 and that position's Open Flowers count >0 in the same completed observation period; drop and report 38 open-flower inconsistencies and one 34 token without imputation
fixed_analysis.exposure: individual flower-hours = 0.5 × sum of open flower count at individual's position across all completed 30-minute site×year sessions; zero exposure is an unavailable prediction value, never treated as 0 visits-per-flower
fixed_analysis.visitation_coordinate: x_vis_eff = log1p(count visits by guild AH or BF / individual flower-hours)
fixed_analysis.total_visitation_coordinate: x_vis_total = log1p(count valid flower-position visits of any taxon / individual flower-hours), same filtering
fixed_analysis.focal_outcome: y = log1p(field 'seed total') for complete, nonnegative source records; do not replace with 'seed set_true', fruit set or greenhouse seed count after viewing outcomes
fixed_analysis.test: Leave-one-whole-site-out fourfold cross-validation, keeping both years of held-out site out; ridge Gaussian least squares, lambda=1.0 for standardized non-intercept predictors; training centering/scaling only; never tune lambda
fixed_analysis.primary_contrast: MSE(log1p seeds) held-out M0 minus M1; positive means effective-visitation predictor improves held-out prediction
fixed_analysis.reporting: Report all 4 site fold MSE, pooled 252-eligible-observation MSE and MAE, genotype-specific checks as descriptive only, source attrition and predictor variance. No site-year pseudoreplication p-values.
exploratory_contrasts: M0 vs M2 all visit rate
M1 vs M2 quality-aware vs total visit rate
fixed_analysis.bounded_success_label: Within this one trial programme, useful predictive increment only if aggregate pooled delta MSE>0 and at least 3/4 site-fold deltas positive; not independent species replication, mechanistic causality or natural eco-genetic law
fixed_analysis.failure_label: NO_ROBUST_SINGLE_PROGRAMME_INCREMENT if primary threshold not met; stop, do not retune
stop_conditions: Source SHA mismatch or malformed workbook
Not exactly 256 field-to-position and 256 S locus joins
any visit datum outside 1-32 is counted in valid numerator
more than recorded 38 zero-open visits without separately logged source-only erratum
A numeric field outcome source lacks expected 252 eligible records
a site fold lacks both genotype classes
no admissible flower-hours exposure for any seed-complete individual

claim_firewall.original_study_result_known: SC plants produced 17–26% more seed but experienced seed discounting, and original paper already examined group visits and single-visit efficacy
prohibited: novel identification of genetic compatibility independent of SC/SI
natural proof of a universal sorting-repair boundary
generality to islands and cities from four sites in one experimental programme
substitution of greenhouse plants as field plant records
claiming pollen visits prove genetically compatible fertilization
confusing held-out prediction with randomized treatment effect
claim_firewall.publication_scope: separate exploratory within-source analysis, not a new flagship result, not submitted
